name: Tabitha Bullock Deactivated
description: Ensures that the outgoing agent Tabitha Bullock (user_id = 3) has been correctly marked inactive after the case handoff.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM user WHERE user_id = 3 AND first_name = 'Tabitha' AND last_name = 'Bullock' AND active = 0;

name: All Active Tabitha Cases Reassigned To Lisa
description: Checks that both active cases formerly assigned to Tabitha (251, 1142) are now assigned to Lisa Smith (user_id = 496) AND placed under Case Assignment_3 (group_id = 44), regardless of state.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customer_case WHERE case_id IN (251, 1142) AND assigned_to = 496 AND assignment_group_id = 44;

name: Lisa Is Member Of Case Assignment_3
description: Confirms that Lisa Smith (user_id = 496) has been added as a member of the Case Assignment_3 group (group_id = 44).

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM user_group_member WHERE group_id = 44 AND user_id = 496;

name: Notification Sent To Brandon
description: Ensures that a report notification was successfully sent to the portal contact (Brandon Davis, user_id 10) for case (case_id = 251).

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM notification n JOIN customer_case c ON n.case_id = c.case_id JOIN contact ct ON c.contact_id = ct.contact_id JOIN user u ON ct.portal_user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.case_id = 251 AND u.email = 'brandon.davis@vehementcap.com' AND n.type = 'report' AND n.status = 'success';
